precommitted_interpretation_checks: Reported net revenue rises +1515 USD million Q3 minus Q2, but net income falls -594 and diluted EPS falls -0.17 USD/share. Rising revenue does not by itself establish improved earnings or economic value.
Managed-basis revenue rises +1440 USD million; this is a separately labeled non-GAAP basis and must not be substituted for reported revenue or mixed into a GAAP earnings bridge.

Noninterest expense rises +502 and provision for credit losses rises +554 USD million. These are observed co-movements, but the six selected rows do not fully reconcile net income or prove which line caused the decline.
The Q3 source repeats Q2 values in its second numeric column; all six selected Q2 comparators should match the Q2 current-quarter release.
The selected snapshot has no full tax, segment, share-count or notable-item detail and does not prove a durable trend or trading conclusion.
